questions.questionHtml: The magnitude of the vector A = 3î − 4ĵ is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — |A| = √(3² + (−4)²) = √25 = 5
Step 2 — Component ka negative nishaan square me khatam ho jaata hai
Step 3 — Magnitude hamesha positive hota hai, isliye −5 kabhi nahi.

questions.questionHtml: For the scalars p = 5 and q = −2, the values of p + q and p · q are respectively
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Scalar me keval sankhya hoti hai, disha nahi
Step 2 — Addition: p + q = 5 + (−2) = 3
Step 3 — Multiplication: p · q = 5 × (−2) = −10, nishaan badal jaata hai.

questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is NOT a unit vector
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Unit vector ka magnitude exactly 1 hona chahiye
Step 2 — |î + ĵ| = √(1 + 1) = √2 ≠ 1, atah yeh unit vector nahi
Step 3 — |0.6î + 0.8ĵ| = √(0.36 + 0.64) = 1 ✓
Step 4 — kisi bhi vector ko uske magnitude se divide karne se unit vector ban jaata hai.

questions.questionHtml: If |A| = 3, |B| = 4 and A · B = 6, the angle between the two vectors is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Definition A · B = AB cosθ se cosθ = {6~12} = 0.5
Step 2 — θ = cos⁻¹(0.5) = 60°
Step 3 — Dot product ka result scalar hota hai — keval sankhya, disha nahi.

questions.questionHtml: If A = 2î + 3ĵ + x k̂ and B = î − 2ĵ + 4 k̂ are perpendicular to each other, then x equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Perpendicular ka arth A · B = 0
Step 2 — Components ka product jodo: 2(1) + 3(−2) + x(4) = 0
Step 3 — 2 − 6 + 4x = 0 se x = 1
Step 4 — do vectors perpendicular ho sakte hain bina zero bane — yahi dot product ki khaasiyat hai.

questions.questionHtml: If |A| = 3, |B| = 4 and the angle between them is 30°, then the magnitude |A × B| equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Formula |A × B| = AB sinθ = 3 × 4 × sin 30°
Step 2 — sin 30° = {1~2}, atah magnitude = 6
Step 3 — 12 tab milta agar sin 30° ki jagah 1 rakh dete
Step 4 — direction plane ke normal par hoti hai (right-hand rule).

questions.questionHtml: If A · (B × C) = 5, then the value of (A × B) · C is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Scalar triple product cyclic order me aprivaartit rehta hai: A · (B × C) = B · (C × A) = C · (A × B)
Step 2 — iskar (A × B) · C = 5
Step 3 — koi do vectors aapas me swap karo to keval nishaan badalta hai.

questions.questionHtml: For two non-zero vectors, the two conditions A · B = 0 and A × B = 0 cannot hold simultaneously. The reason is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — A · B = AB cosθ = 0 se cosθ = 0, yaani θ = 90°
Step 2 — A × B = AB sinθ = 0 se sinθ = 0, yaani θ = 0° ya 180°
Step 3 — ek hi angle dono shartein poori nahi kar sakta, atah dono conditions virodhi hain.

questions.questionHtml: The magnitude of the resultant of the displacements d₁ = 2î + 3ĵ, d₂ = −î + ĵ and d₃ = 4î − 3ĵ, in metres, is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Same axis ke components alag-alag jodo: Rₓ = 2 − 1 + 4 = 5, R_y = 3 + 1 − 3 = 1
Step 2 — |R| = √(5² + 1²) = √26 ≈ 5.1 m
Step 3 — 13 m keval tab aata hai jab teeno displacements ek hi line me hon.

questions.questionHtml: If y = x³ + 5x, then {dy~dx} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Power rule {d~dx} xⁿ = nx^(n−1) ko har pad par alag-alag lagu karo
Step 2 — {d(x³)~dx} = 3x² aur {d(5x)~dx} = 5
Step 3 — uttar 3x² + 5 — 5, x se guna hone wala constant hai, isliye derivative me bacha rehta hai.

questions.questionHtml: The derivative {d(√x)~dx} is equal to
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — √x ko x^({1~2}) roop me likho
Step 2 — power rule se {1~2}x^(−{1~2}) = {1~2√x}
Step 3 — x = 0 par yeh infinite ho jaata hai, kyunki vahaan curve vertical (y-axis ko sparsh) ho jaata hai.

questions.questionHtml: Differentiate x² sin x with respect to x.
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Product rule lagao: (uv)′ = u′v + uv′
Step 2 — yahaan u = x², u′ = 2x, v = sin x, v′ = cos x
Step 3 — uttar 2x sin x + x² cos x — dono pad plus me jodte hain, minus nahi aata.

questions.questionHtml: The derivative {dv~dx} of the function v = {x~x²} is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Pehle cancel karke simplify karo: {x~x²} = {1~x} = x⁻¹
Step 2 — derivative = −1 · x⁻² = −{1~x²}
Step 3 — quotient rule se bhi wahi milta hai, par pehle simplify karna tez aur galti-rahit hai.

questions.questionHtml: If u = sin 3x, then {du~dx} is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Chain rule: bahar wale ka derivative cos 3x, andar wale 3x ka derivative 3
Step 2 — dono ko guna karo: 3 cos 3x
Step 3 — keval cos 3x likh dena sabse common pariksha-truti hai.

questions.questionHtml: The slope of the curve y = e^(2x) at the point x = 0 is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — {dy~dx} = 2e^(2x) — chain rule ka factor 2 bahar aata hai
Step 2 — x = 0 rakhne par 2e⁰ = 2 × 1 = 2
Step 3 — slope ka arth tanα, jahaan α tangent ka x-axis se bana angle hai.

questions.questionHtml: {d~dx} ln 5x equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Log ka rule: ln 5x = ln 5 + ln x
Step 2 — ln 5 ek constant hai, iska derivative zero
Step 3 — bachta hai {1~x} — log ke andar ka constant factor slope nahi badalta.

questions.questionHtml: If y = x^(-2) cos x, then {dy~dx} is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Product rule: u = x^(-2) aur v = cos x
Step 2 — u′ = −2x^(-3), v′ = −sin x
Step 3 — uttar −2x^(-3) cos x − x^(-2) sin x
Step 4 — donon pad negative hain kyonki x badhne par dono factors ghatte hain.

questions.questionHtml: If x = t² and y = t³, then {dy~dx} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Parametric rule: {dy~dx} = {dy~dt} ÷ {dx~dt}
Step 2 — {dy~dt} = 3t² aur {dx~dt} = 2t
Step 3 — anupat {3t²~2t} = {3t~2}
Step 4 — t = 0 par dono derivatives zero hain, vahaan yeh vidhi kaam nahi karti.

questions.questionHtml: For a displacement given by x = A sin ωt, the acceleration is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — v = {dx~dt} = Aω cos ωt
Step 2 — phir a = {dv~dt} = −Aω² sin ωt
Step 3 — kyonki x = A sin ωt, atah a = −ω²x
Step 4 — acceleration, displacement ke samanupati aur uske viparit disha me — yahi SHM ki paribhasha hai.

questions.questionHtml: If f(t) = (3t² + 1)(2t − 1), then f′(t) is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Product rule: (6t)(2t − 1) + (3t² + 1)(2)
Step 2 — brackets kholo: 12t² − 6t + 6t² + 2
Step 3 — jodne par 18t² − 6t + 2
Step 4 — pehle brackets kholkar differentiate karke bhi yahi check kar sakte ho.

questions.questionHtml: {d~dx} ln(cos x) equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Chain rule: {d~du} ln u = {1~u}, yahaan u = cos x
Step 2 — {du~dx} = −sin x, atah {1~cos x} × (−sin x)
Step 3 — uttar −tan x — andar ka function ghat raha hai, isliye nishaan negative.

questions.questionHtml: {d~dx} {x + 1~x − 1} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Quotient rule me numerator: (1)(x − 1) − (x + 1)(1) = −2
Step 2 — denominator = (x − 1)², jo hamesha positive hai
Step 3 — uttar −{2~(x − 1)²} — nishaan ka faisala sirf numerator karta hai.

questions.questionHtml: Differentiate x eˣ with respect to x.
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Product rule: (x)′eˣ + x(eˣ)′ = eˣ + x eˣ
Step 2 — eˣ common lo: eˣ(1 + x)
Step 3 — yahi identity aage ∫ eˣ(1 + x)dx = x eˣ + C ban jaati hai.

questions.questionHtml: ∫ x² dx equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Rule ∫ xⁿdx = {xⁿ⁺¹~n + 1} + C me n = 2 rakho
Step 2 — uttar {x³~3} + C
Step 3 — janch: {d~dx}{x³~3} = x² ✓
Step 4 — 2x + C to derivative ka answer hai, integral ka nahi.

questions.questionHtml: ∫₁² {dx~x²} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — x⁻² ka antiderivative = −x⁻¹ = −{1~x}
Step 2 — upper limit par −{1~2}, lower limit par −1
Step 3 — difference = −{1~2} − (−1) = {1~2}
Step 4 — ln 2 tab aata jab integrand {1~x} hota.

questions.questionHtml: ∫_(0)^(π) sin x dx equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — ∫ sin x dx = −cos x (minus ka dhyan rakho)
Step 2 — limits: (−cos π) − (−cos 0) = 1 + 1
Step 3 — uttar 2, kyonki 0 se π tak curve positive hai
Step 4 — π se 2π tak isi ka value −2 aayega.

questions.questionHtml: ∫ cos ax dx, where a is a non-zero constant, equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Andar ka constant a divide karke bahar aa jaata hai: {sin(ax)~a} + C
Step 2 — janch karo: {d~dx}{sin(ax)~a} = cos(ax) ✓
Step 3 — a se guna karna (a sin ax) truti hai.

questions.questionHtml: ∫_(0)^(a) {dx~√(a² − x²)} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Standard form: ∫ {dx~√(a² − x²)} = sin⁻¹{x~a}
Step 2 — limits: sin⁻¹{a~a} − sin⁻¹0 = sin⁻¹1 − 0
Step 3 — uttar {π~2}. x = a par integrand infinite ho jaata hai, phir bhi kshetraphal simit hai.

questions.questionHtml: ∫₀¹ eˣ dx equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — eˣ ka antiderivative svayan eˣ hota hai
Step 2 — limits: e¹ − e⁰ = e − 1 ≈ 1.718
Step 3 — e⁰ = 1 ghatana bhoolne par galat option 'e' dikhega — wahi trap yahaan rakha gaya hai.

questions.questionHtml: ∫₋ₐᵃ x³ dx equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — x³ ek odd function hai, arthaat f(−x) = −f(x)
Step 2 — origin ke donon taraf ke kshetraphal same magnitude par opposite nishaan ke hote hain, atah yog zero
Step 3 — even function (x² ya |x|) me value double ho jaati.

questions.questionHtml: ∫ {x dx~x² + 1} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Put u = x² + 1, tab du = 2x dx, arthaat x dx = {du~2}
Step 2 — integral = {1~2}∫ {du~u} = {1~2} ln(x² + 1) + C
Step 3 — jab denominator ka derivative numerator me maujood ho, substitution sabse tez marg hai.

questions.questionHtml: ∫ {dx~√(1 − x²)} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Smaran rakho: {d~dx} sin⁻¹x = {1~√(1 − x²)}
Step 2 — atah uttar sin⁻¹x + C
Step 3 — cos⁻¹x ka derivative negative aata hai
Step 4 — denominator me 1 + x² hota to tan⁻¹x milta — keval nishaan ka farak hai.

questions.questionHtml: ∫_(0)^(∞) e^({−t~τ}) dt equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Antiderivative = −τe^({−t~τ}) — τ uthakar bahar aa jaata hai
Step 2 — upper limit t → ∞ par value 0
Step 3 — lower limit t = 0 par value −τ
Step 4 — uttar 0 − (−τ) = τ, isiliye τ ko kul kshetraphal kahte hain.

questions.questionHtml: The solution of the differential equation {dN~dt} = −λN is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Chal-pṛthakkaran: {dN~N} = −λ dt
Step 2 — donon taraf integrate: ln N = −λt + C
Step 3 — initial condition t = 0, N = N₀ se C = ln N₀
Step 4 — uttar N = N₀e^(−λt) — negative exponent kshay dikhata hai.

questions.questionHtml: ∫₁ᵉ {dx~x} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — ∫ {dx~x} = ln x
Step 2 — limits: ln e − ln 1 = 1 − 0 = 1
Step 3 — yahi curve y = {1~x} ke neeche x = 1 se x = e tak ka kshetraphal hai — natural logarithm ki zyamiitiyak paribhasha.

questions.questionHtml: ∫₁² (2t + 3) dt equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Antiderivative: t² + 3t
Step 2 — upper limit t = 2 par 4 + 6 = 10
Step 3 — lower limit t = 1 par 1 + 3 = 4
Step 4 — uttar 10 − 4 = 6 — keval 10 likh dena common galti hai.

questions.questionHtml: {d~dx} ∫₀ˣ t² dt equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Kalan ke maulik pryay se: {d~dx} ∫ₐˣ f(t)dt = f(x)
Step 2 — yahaan f(t) = t², atah seedha uttar x²
Step 3 — pehle integrate karke phir derivative lena vyarth mehnat hai, aur constant bhi zero hi aayega.

questions.questionHtml: ∫₀¹ {dx~1 + x²} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Standard integral: ∫ {dx~1 + x²} = tan⁻¹x + C
Step 2 — limits: tan⁻¹1 − tan⁻¹0 = {π~4} − 0
Step 3 — denominator me 1 − x² hota to {1~2}ln{1 + x~1 − x} jaisa roop milta.

questions.questionHtml: ∫ eˣ(1 + x) dx equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Pehchan lo: ∫ eˣ[f(x) + f′(x)]dx = eˣ f(x) + C
Step 2 — yahaan f = x aur f′ = 1, jo integrand se bilkul mel khaata hai
Step 3 — uttar x eˣ + C (by-parts se bhi wahi, par pehchan tez hai).

questions.questionHtml: The value of ∫₀² (3x² − 2) dx is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Antiderivative: x³ − 2x
Step 2 — upper limit x = 2 par 8 − 4 = 4
Step 3 — lower limit x = 0 par 0
Step 4 — uttar 4 − 0 = 4. Curve 0 se √{2~3} tak negative rehta hai, uske baad positive.

questions.questionHtml: The work W = ∫₀³ 6x² dx, expressed in joules, equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — ∫ 6x²dx = {6x³~3} = 2x³
Step 2 — limits: 2(3)³ − 2(0)³ = 2 × 27 = 54 J
Step 3 — 27 J me coefficient 2 chhoot gaya, 18 J me average-force wali truti aur 162 J me ghaat galat hai.

questions.questionHtml: If log₁₀2 = 0.301, then log₁₀5 equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Logarithms
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — 5 ko {10~2} roop me likho
Step 2 — bhaag ke niyam se log 10 − log 2 = 1 − 0.301
Step 3 — uttar 0.699 — division, logs ke antar ke barabar hota hai.

questions.questionHtml: If ln x = 3, then the value of x is approximately
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Logarithms
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — ln x = 3 ka arth x = e³ (logarithm ki paribhasha)
Step 2 — e ≈ 2.718, atah e³ ≈ 2.718 × 2.718 × 2.718 ≈ 20.1
Step 3 — 9 ya 3 sochna isliye galat kyunki ln ka aadhar 10 nahi, e hai.

questions.questionHtml: If 3ˣ = 20, then x equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Logarithms
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Donon taraf log lo: x log 3 = log 20
Step 2 — iskar x = {log 20~log 3}
Step 3 — values daalo to {1.301~0.477} ≈ 2.73
Step 4 — aadhar same ho to ghaataankon ki tulna seedhi hoti hai
Step 5 — anupat ulta karne par 0.37 aa jaayega.

questions.questionHtml: The expression log a + log b − log c simplifies to
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Logarithms
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — jod gunaa ban jaata hai: log a + log b = log(ab)
Step 2 — ghataav bhaag ban jaata hai: log(ab) − log c = log {ab~c}
Step 3 — ye niyam keval ek hi aadhar ke logarithms par saath lagu hote hain.

questions.questionHtml: Using the binomial approximation, the value of √1.04 is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Binomial & Series
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — 1.04 = 1 + 0.04 aur (1 + x)ⁿ ≈ 1 + nx, jo |x| ≪ 1 ke liye maany hai
Step 2 — yahaan n = {1~2}, atah 1 + {1~2} × 0.04 = 1.02
Step 3 — exact √1.04 = 1.0198 — approximation isi ke bahut paas deta hai.

questions.questionHtml: In the expansion of (1 + y)^({1~2}), the term containing y² is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Binomial & Series
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Is pad ka gunaaank {n(n − 1)~2!} hota hai
Step 2 — n = {1~2} rakhne par {(0.5)(−0.5)~2} = −{1~8}
Step 3 — atah pad = −{y²~8}. Yeh negative pad batata hai ki 1 + {y~2} thoda adhik value de deta hai.

questions.questionHtml: The Maclaurin series of sin x is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Binomial & Series
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — sin x ek odd function hai, isliye keval odd ghaaten aayengi
Step 2 — x = 0 par derivatives ka pattern 1, 0, −1, 0, +1 … hai, nishaan ekantar badalte hain
Step 3 — uttar x − {x³~3!} + {x⁵~5!} − …
Step 4 — dusra option cos x (even function) ka vistar hai.

questions.questionHtml: lim (x→0) {1 − cos x~x²} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Binomial & Series
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Seedha put karne par {0~0} roop banta hai, atah series istemaal karo
Step 2 — cos x = 1 − {x²~2!} + {x⁴~4!} − …, isse 1 − cos x ≈ {x²~2}
Step 3 — limit = {x²~2} ÷ x² → {1~2}
Step 4 — L'Hospital niyam se bhi wahi.

questions.questionHtml: lim (x→0) {sin ax~x} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Binomial & Series
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — L'Hospital niyam: numerator ka derivative a cos ax, denominator ka derivative 1
Step 2 — donon par x = 0 rakhne par a cos 0 = a
Step 3 — yehi standard limit {sin ax~ax} → 1 ka dusra roop hai, jo chhote-kon approximation ki bunyaad hai.

questions.questionHtml: The expansion of ln(1 + x), for small values of x, is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Binomial & Series
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Pehle jaani hui series: {1~1 + x} = 1 − x + x² − x³ + …
Step 2 — iska 0 se x tak pad-dar-pad integration karo
Step 3 — milta hai x − {x²~2} + {x³~3} − …, jo |x| ke 1 se kam hone par abhisarit hoti hai.

questions.questionHtml: Using the small-angle approximation, the value of sin 2° is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Trigonometry
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Sab pehle degrees ko radians me badlo: 2° = {2π~180} = 0.0349 rad
Step 2 — chhote kon ke liye sinθ ≈ θ maan lo
Step 3 — uttar 0.035 — degree me direct approximation lagana niyam-virudh hai.

questions.questionHtml: For a very small angle θ, the quantity tanθ is approximately
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Trigonometry
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — tanθ = {sinθ~cosθ} likho
Step 2 — chhote kon par sinθ ≈ θ aur cosθ ≈ 1 − {θ²~2} ≈ 1
Step 3 — anupat keval θ ban jaata hai
Step 4 — yahi approximation lola ka T = 2π√{l~g} nikalne deta hai.

questions.questionHtml: One radian, expressed in degrees, is nearly
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Trigonometry
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — π rad = 180° (paribhasha se)
Step 2 — iskar 1 rad = {180~π} = 57.3°
Step 3 — trikonaamitiyak fhalanon ke derivative aur integral ke sutr tabhi sahi hain jab kon radians me maapa gaya ho.

questions.questionHtml: In T = 2π√{l~g}, if the percentage errors in l and g are 2% and 1%, the maximum percentage error in T is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Errors & Units
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Truti-prasar: ghaat relative truti ko multiply karta hai
Step 2 — {ΔT~T} = {1~2}{Δl~l} + {1~2}{Δg~g}
Step 3 — = {1~2}(2%) + {1~2}(1%) = 1% + 0.5% = 1.5%
Step 4 — constant 2π koi truti nahi deta.

questions.questionHtml: For a density ρ = {m~V} with percentage errors of 2% in mass and 3% in volume, the maximum percentage error in ρ is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Errors & Units
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Gunaaank ya bhaag me saapeksh trutiyaan judti hain
Step 2 — {Δρ~ρ} = {Δm~m} + {ΔV~V} = 2% + 3%
Step 3 — uttar 5% — yeh adhikatam seema hai
Step 4 — trutiyaan svatantra (random) hon to √(2² + 3²) ≈ 3.6% lagta.

questions.questionHtml: The area under a velocity–time graph represents
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Graphs
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Paribhasha se: s = ∫ v dt
Step 2 — har patli patti ka kshetraphal v × Δt, unka yog = displacement
Step 3 — usi graph ki slope {dv~dt} tvaran deti hai — kshetraphal aur slope me chunav dhyan se karo.

questions.questionHtml: For x = 2t² − 6t + 4, the acceleration at t = 3 s is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — v = {dx~dt} = 4t − 6 aur a = {dv~dt} = 4 m s⁻²
Step 2 — yeh samay se mukt hai, atah t = 3 s par bhi 4 m s⁻²
Step 3 — x–t graph parabolik hai yaani tvaran akar
Step 4 — −6 to velocity ka prarambhik gunaaank hai.

questions.questionHtml: As shown in the figure, the work done by the force over the displacement from 0 to 4 m is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Graphs
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — W = ∫ F dx = vakra ke neeche ka kshetraphal
Step 2 — yahaan trapezium bana hai (F = 2 N se 10 N tak)
Step 3 — kshetraphal = {1~2}(2 + 10)(4) = 24 J
Step 4 — same result ∫₀⁴ (2 + 2x)dx = [2x + x²]₀⁴ = 8 + 16 = 24 J.

questions.questionHtml: The slope of the tangent to an x–t graph at a point gives
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Graphs
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Tangent ki slope = seema me {Δx~Δt} = {dx~dt}, arthaat usi kshn ka velocity
Step 2 — do binduon ko milane wali jya (chord) ki slope ausat velocity deti hai
Step 3 — jahan graph flat hai (ucchisht bindu) vahaan slope zero, atah velocity zero.

questions.questionHtml: The slope of the tangent to the curve y = {1~x + a} at x = 0 is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Graphs
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Ghaat −1 me likho: y = (x + a)^(-1)
Step 2 — {dy~dx} = −(x + a)^(-2)
Step 3 — x = 0 rakhne par −{1~a²}. Curve neeche ki or ja raha hai, isliye slope negative hi aana chahiye.

questions.questionHtml: If x varies as t√t, then the velocity varies with time as
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Graphs
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — x = kt√t maankar derivative lo: v = {3k~2}√t, yaani v ∝ √t
Step 2 — tvaran a = {dv~dt} = {3k~4√t} — samay ke saath ghat-ta hai
Step 3 — graph ka slope badhta hai par curvature kam hoti jaati hai.

questions.questionHtml: Over one complete cycle, the average value of sin²ωt is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Sarvasmrika: sin²θ = {1 − cos 2θ~2}
Step 2 — poore chakron me cos 2ωt ka ausat zero hota hai (samiti se)
Step 3 — atah ausat = {1~2}
Step 4 — isi liye prityaavarti dhara ki ausat shakti {1~2}i₀²R likhi jaati hai.

questions.questionHtml: For x = t² + 2t in SI units, the velocity at t = 2 s is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Velocity = {dx~dt} = 2t + 2
Step 2 — t = 2 s rakhne par 4 + 2 = 6 m s⁻¹
Step 3 — yahi value x–t graph par usi bindu ki tangent ki slope se bhi padhi ja sakti hai.

questions.questionHtml: A current is 1 A during the first half and 3 A during the second half of a cycle. Its rms value is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — rms ka arth: root of the mean of the squares
Step 2 — square karo: 1² = 1 aur 3² = 9
Step 3 — mean = {1 + 9~2} = 5, atah root = √5 ≈ 2.24 A
Step 4 — saadhaaran ausat 2 A hamesha rms se kam aata hai.

questions.questionHtml: The minimum value of K = 2v² − 8v + 10 is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Ativyapti ke liye {dK~dv} = 4v − 8 = 0 se v = 2
Step 2 — K(2) = 2(4) − 8(2) + 10 = 8 − 16 + 10 = 6
Step 3 — doosra derivative {d²K~dv²} = +4, yaani dhan, atah yeh bindu nyoontam hai.

questions.questionHtml: For x = 4t − 3t², the velocity becomes zero at the time t equal to
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — v = {dx~dt} = 4 − 6t
Step 2 — ishe zero ke barabar rakho: 4 − 6t = 0
Step 3 — t = {2~3} s — yahi ucchisht kshn hai, jahan velocity timik roop se zero hoti hai par tvaran −6 m s⁻² bana rehta hai.

questions.questionHtml: A particle starts with u = 10 m s⁻¹ and moves with a = −2 m s⁻². Its displacement is maximum at the time t equal to
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Displacement tab adhiktam jab palta hai, arthaat v = 0
Step 2 — v = u + at se 0 = 10 − 2t
Step 3 — iskar t = 5 s
Step 4 — us kshn tak displacement {u²~2a} = 25 m hoga — prashn me samay maanga gaya hai.

questions.questionHtml: A constant force of 10 N acts for 2 s. The change in momentum, in kg m s⁻¹, is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Aavedya–sanveg pramay: Δp = ∫ F dt
Step 2 — bal akar hai to integral saadhaaran gunaaank ban jaata hai: 10 × 2 = 20
Step 3 — chhota bal lambe samay tak lage to bhi bada sanveg-parivartan mil sakta hai.

questions.questionHtml: For U(x) = 4x² − 8x, the equilibrium position and its nature are
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Bal F = −{dU~dx} = −(8x − 8)
Step 2 — samya ke liye F = 0 se x = 1
Step 3 — {d²U~dx²} = +8, yaani dhan, arthaat sthiti-urja nyoontam hai
Step 4 — urja-vakra ka nyoontam bindu sthaayi samya dikhata hai.

questions.questionHtml: A sample contains 10⁶ nuclei with a half-life of 10⁵ s. The number of nuclei remaining after 3 × 10⁵ s is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Kitne ardh-aayu bate: n = {3 × 10⁵~10⁵} = 3
Step 2 — N = N₀{1~2}ⁿ = {10⁶~2³} = {10⁶~8}
Step 3 — uttar 0.125 × 10⁶
Step 4 — N = N₀e^(−λt) me λ = {ln 2~T½} daalne se bhi yahi milta hai.

questions.questionHtml: The perpendicular distance of the point (2, 3) from the line 3x + 4y = 12 is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Sutra d = {|Ax₀ + By₀ + C|~√(A² + B²)}
Step 2 — ansh = |3(2) + 4(3) − 12| = |12 − 12| = 0
Step 3 — atah d = 0 — bindu rekhapar hi sthit hai
Step 4 — aise prashn me yahi pehli janch hai.

questions.questionHtml: The period of small oscillations of a simple pendulum of length 1 m, taking g = 10 m s⁻², is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — T = 2π√{l~g} = 6.28 × √{1~10}
Step 2 — √0.1 ≈ 0.316, atah T ≈ 6.28 × 0.316 ≈ 1.99 ≈ 2 s
Step 3 — yeh sutra keval sinθ ≈ θ wali laghu-ikuti dohon ke liye maany hai.

questions.questionHtml: A charge flows with a current i = 2t (in amperes) from t = 0 to t = 3 s. The total charge, in coulombs, is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — i = {dq~dt} se q = ∫ i dt = ∫₀³ 2t dt
Step 2 — antiderivative t², evaluate: 3² − 0 = 9
Step 3 — uttar 9 C
Step 4 — i–t graph ka trikon {1~2} × 3 × 6 = 9 C se turant janch ho jaati hai.

questions.questionHtml: A body starts from rest with an acceleration a = 4t m s⁻². Its velocity at t = 3 s is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — dv = a dt integrate karo: v = ∫₀³ 4t dt = [2t²]₀³
Step 2 — = 2(3)² − 0 = 18 m s⁻¹ (v₀ = 0 hone se integration constant zero)
Step 3 — a–t graph ka kshetraphal {1~2} × 3 × 12 = 18 se bhi wahi.

questions.questionHtml: If the electric potential is V = {k~r}, then the field E = −{dV~dr} varies with r as
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — V = k r⁻¹ likho
Step 2 — {dV~dr} = −k r⁻²
Step 3 — E = −{dV~dr} = {k~r²}, arthaat E ∝ {1~r²}
Step 4 — negative nishaan keval disha batata hai (jis or potential ghat raha hai).

questions.questionHtml: The moment of inertia of a uniform rod of mass M and length L, about a perpendicular axis through its centre, is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Rekhik ghanta λ = {M~L} aur element dm = λ dx
Step 2 — I = ∫ x²dm = λ{x³~3}, limits −{L~2} se +{L~2}
Step 3 — = λ{L³~12} = {ML²~12}
Step 4 — axis rod ke sire par se guzre to limits 0 se L aur uttar {ML²~3}.

questions.questionHtml: The volume of a cone of base radius 0.1 m and height 0.3 m, keeping π, is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Height z par trijya rakheek ghat-ti hai: r(1 − {z~h})
Step 2 — disk ka aayatan πr² dz me samakalit karo
Step 3 — V = {πr²h~3} = {π(0.01)(0.3)~3} = 0.001π m³ — same base aur height ke vartul ka ek-tehaai bhaag.

questions.questionHtml: The work done by the force F = 4 − x newtons over the displacement from 0 to 3 m is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Work & Energy
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — W = ∫₀³ (4 − x)dx = [4x − {x²~2}]₀³
Step 2 — = (12 − 4.5) − 0 = 7.5 J
Step 3 — 12 J tab aayega jab bal ko akar 4 N maan liya jaaye
Step 4 — graph ka trapezium {1~2}(4 + 1)(3) = 7.5 se janch karo.

questions.questionHtml: A force of 8 N makes an angle of 60° with the x-axis. Its y-component and the value of tanθ are
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Jis axis se kon maapa jaata hai, us ka component cos se milta hai
Step 2 — Fₓ = 8 cos 60° = 4 N aur F_y = 8 sin 60° = 4√3 N
Step 3 — tanθ = {F_y~Fₓ} = {4√3~4} = √3, jo 60° ke saath mel khaata hai.

questions.questionHtml: If A = 2î + λĵ and B = 3î − 4ĵ add up to a vector along the x-axis, then λ equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — A + B = 5î + (λ − 4)ĵ
Step 2 — x-axis ke anudish ka arth hai ki ĵ ka component zero ho
Step 3 — λ − 4 = 0 se λ = 4 — disha-nibandh ko equation me badalna hi is prashn ki kali hai.

questions.questionHtml: A tangential force of 40 N acts at a distance r = 0.5 m from the axis. The magnitude of the torque is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Bal-aaghurn τ = rF sinθ, jahaan θ, r aur F ke beech ka kon hai
Step 2 — spurshiya bal ke liye θ = 90° aur sin 90° = 1, yaani aaghurn adhiktam
Step 3 — τ = 0.5 × 40 = 20 N m. Bal trijya ke anudish hota to τ zero.

questions.questionHtml: The angle between the vectors A = î + √3 ĵ and B = î − √3 ĵ is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — A · B = 1(1) + √3(−√3) = 1 − 3 = −2
Step 2 — |A| = |B| = √(1 + 3) = 2
Step 3 — cosθ = {−2~4} = −{1~2} se θ = 120°
Step 4 — dot product negative ho to kon 90° se adhika hota hai.

questions.questionHtml: A boat moves at 3 m s⁻¹ due north while the current flows at 1 m s⁻¹ due east. Its speed relative to the ground and the angle with the east direction are
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — East = x aur north = y maankar v = 1î + 3ĵ
Step 2 — |v| = √(1² + 3²) = √10 ≈ 3.16 m s⁻¹
Step 3 — kon = tan⁻¹{3~1} = 71.6°
Step 4 — sankhyaon ko seedha jodna (4 m s⁻¹) keval tab sahi hai jab donon ek hi rekha me hon.

questions.questionHtml: Statement 1: for non-zero vectors, A · B = 0 means they are perpendicular. Statement 2: A · B is a scalar. Statement 3: A · B = 0 forces A = 0 or B = 0. The correct statements are
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — A · B = AB cosθ
Step 2 — non-zero vectors me yeh keval cosθ = 0 se zero hota hai, yaani θ = 90° — Statement 1 sahi
Step 3 — result sankhya aur cosθ ka gunaan hai, koi disha nahi — Statement 2 sahi
Step 4 — beejganit ka ab = 0 wala tark vectors par lagu nahi hota — Statement 3 galat.

questions.questionHtml: From the identity A × (B × C) = B(A · C) − C(A · B), the vector A × (B × C) lies

options.html: in the plane of A and B
in the plane of B and C
perpendicular to A and outside that plane

questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Daayaan paksh αB + βC ke roop me hai, jahaan α = A · C aur β = A · B
Step 2 — B aur C ke aise kisii bhi rekhik snyojan ka vector unhi ke tal me rehta hai
Step 3 — smaran-niyam: BAC − CAB.

questions.questionHtml: The scalar projection of A = 3î + 4ĵ on the direction of B = 5î + 12ĵ is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — Saraksh prakshhep = {A · B~|B|}
Step 2 — A · B = 15 + 48 = 63 aur |B| = √(25 + 144) = 13
Step 3 — uttar {63~13} ≈ 4.85
Step 4 — |B| se bhaag karna bhool jaane par 63 mil jaata hai — yahi prachalit truti hai.

questions.questionHtml: If A = 2î + ĵ + 3k̂ and B = 4î + λĵ + 6k̂ are parallel, then λ equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Samantarata ki shart: components samaanupati hone chahiye
Step 2 — {4~2} = {6~3} = 2, atah {λ~1} = 2 hona chahiye
Step 3 — iskar λ = 2. Doosra tareeka: A × B = 0 se bhi yahi shart milti hai.

questions.questionHtml: For A = î + ĵ + k̂, B = ĵ + k̂ and C = î, the scalar triple product [A B C] equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Yahaan A = B + C, atah teeno vectors ek hi tal me hain (samtliya)
Step 2 — samtliya vectors se bana samaantaraaghtak chaptā hota hai, uska aayatan zero
Step 3 — Determinant kholkar: 1(0) − 1(−1) + 1(−1) = 0 ✓.

questions.questionHtml: The cross product î × ĵ equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Vectors
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Right-hand niyam: î se ĵ ki or ungli ghumaao, angootha k̂ dikhayega
Step 2 — chakraakiy kram î → ĵ → k̂ me gunaanhan dhan milta hai
Step 3 — kram badalne par ĵ × î = −k̂, aur ek hi aksh par î × î = 0.

questions.questionHtml: If a = ct and the particle starts from rest, its velocity is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — dv = a dt integrate karo: v = ∫₀ᵗ ct dt = c{t²~2} = {ct²~2}
Step 2 — v₀ = 0 hone se integration constant zero
Step 3 — a–t graph ke trikon ka kshetraphal {1~2} · t · (ct) se bhi wahi value milti hai.

questions.questionHtml: The acceleration of a body on a smooth (frictionless) incline of 30°, taking g = 10 m s⁻², is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Gurutvaakarshak bal ka tal ke anudish wala bhaag mg sinθ hota hai
Step 2 — ma = mg sin 30° se a = 10 × 0.5 = 5 m s⁻²
Step 3 — mg cosθ keval abhilamb bal ko santulit karta hai, gati me yogdaan nahi deta.

questions.questionHtml: Using the binomial approximation for L = ∫₀¹ √(1 + 4x²) dx, the value of L is about
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — (1 + u)^({1~2}) ≈ 1 + {u~2} lo aur u = 4x² rakho
Step 2 — integrand ≈ 1 + 2x²
Step 3 — iska samakalan: [x + {2x³~3}]₀¹ = 1 + {2~3} = {5~3} ≈ 1.67 m
Step 4 — manyata 4x² ≪ 1 hai, isliye uttar anumaanit roop me liya gaya.

questions.questionHtml: Over half an oscillation, the average magnitude of the restoring force for x = A sin ωt is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — Bal F = mω²A sinωt ka parimaann ausat nikaalna hai
Step 2 — ausat = {ω~π}∫ F dt, limits 0 se {π~ω} tak (ardh-aavart)
Step 3 — ∫ sinωt dt = {2~ω} rakhne par uttar {2mω²A~π}
Step 4 — |sin| ka ausat {2~π} aur sin² ka {1~2} — dono me bhed rakho.

questions.questionHtml: The integral ∫_(1)^(∞) {kq~r²} dr represents

options.html: the average field over the region

questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — kq∫_(1)^(∞) r⁻²dr = kq[−{1~r}]_(1)^(∞)
Step 2 — upper limit par {1~r} → 0 aur lower limit par {1~1} = 1
Step 3 — uttar kq, arthaat V = {kq~r} ka value r = 1 par, kyonki E = −{dV~dr}
Step 4 — r → 0 par yeh samakalan apasaari ho jaata hai.

questions.questionHtml: The maximum area of a rectangle whose perimeter is 40 m is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Bhujaayein x aur 20 − x (kyonki ardh-paridhi 20 m hai)
Step 2 — kshetraphal A = x(20 − x)
Step 3 — {dA~dx} = 20 − 2x = 0 se x = 10
Step 4 — {d²A~dx²} = −2, yaani negative, atah adhiktam confirm hota hai, atah 100 m² — chaarbetu (square) hi shreshh hai.

questions.questionHtml: If x = a cos ωt and y = a sin ωt, then {dx~dt} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Differentiation
Sahi Jawab: B
Step 1 — Chain rule: {d(cos ωt)~dt} = −ω sinωt
Step 2 — iskar {dx~dt} = −aω sinωt
Step 3 — isi tarah {dy~dt} = aω cosωt
Step 4 — donon ka varg-yog v² = a²ω² deta hai, yaani chaal akar rehti hai (vrttaaki gati).

questions.questionHtml: The path traced out by the motion x = 3 cos t, y = 4 sin t is
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: C
Step 1 — {x~3} = cos t aur {y~4} = sin t likho
Step 2 — donon ka varg jodo: cos²t + sin²t = 1
Step 3 — milta hai {x²~9} + {y²~16} = 1 — ardh-aksh 3 aur 4, atah deerghvritt
Step 4 — dono ardh-aksh barabar hote to vritt milta.

questions.questionHtml: In a semiconductor {1~n}{dn~dx} = −10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ and {kT~e} = 0.026 V. The diffusion field E = −{kT~e}{1~n}{dn~dx} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Calculus in Physics
Sahi Jawab: D
Step 1 — E = −(0.026) × (−10⁻⁷)
Step 2 — do negative nishanon ka gunaaank dhan hota hai
Step 3 — 0.026 ko 2.6 × 10⁻² likho, ghaatein jodo: 10⁻² × 10⁻⁷ = 10⁻⁹
Step 4 — uttar +2.6 × 10⁻⁹ V m⁻¹ — 10⁻⁷ isliye galat kyunki vah gunaaank ke bina aaata hai.

questions.questionHtml: ∫ (cos x + sin x) dx evaluated from 0 to {π~2} equals
questions.explanationHtml:
Explanation Integration
Sahi Jawab: A
Step 1 — Rekhikta se donon ka alag-alag samakalan: ∫ cos x dx = sin x, ∫ sin x dx = −cos x
Step 2 — limits: [sin x − cos x]_(0)^({π~2}) = (1 − 0) − (0 − 1)
Step 3 — uttar 2 — pehle chaturthaans aur doosre chaturthaans ke kshetraphal aapas me barabar hote hain.
